Earth and City 10 (Expression of Ideas)

A Korean stock composite of 2007: a glowing wireframe globe, an airliner, and a clean skyline over blue water and green banks.

Context

Gongu Madang (Korea Copyright Commission) records the work “지구와 도시 10(발상의 표현)” by 아사달 (Asadal), created 2007-10-29, a Photoshop composite, offered under CC BY. Gongu record.

The Wikipedia Frutiger Aero article uses this image for the claim that the style “often depicts the natural in tandem with digital elements.” Wikipedia: Frutiger Aero.

CARI links Asadal’s design mall to the style and published an interview with its CEO, Chang N. Suh (Yunseon Yang and Sofi Xian, June 2026). It reports that Asadal donated image assets to the Korea Copyright Commission for free use under CC BY. The Future Is Aesthetic.

Observed

  • A deep-blue sky fades to pale cyan at the horizon, with small white clouds.
  • A translucent, glowing globe at upper right is wrapped in white orbit lines and has a star-shaped lens flare at its edge.
  • An airliner at upper left trails a thin white line toward the globe.
  • Glass towers rise from green banks beside still blue water; a red arch bridge sits at the right edge.
  • Faint translucent hexagons float in the middle of the sky.

Why it belongs

This is the style as commercial stock: the “globe plus skyline plus nature” image that filled corporate web headers. Its mood is frictionless progress — clean air travel, clean water, clean city.

Borrow

For a hero image, stack three layers: a blue sky gradient, a glowing translucent object (globe, orb, or bubble), and a green or water horizon.

Use one lens flare or star highlight as a focal accent, not many.
